pages.title: Fibre
pages.text: Break tagged grass or other fibre sources. A primitive knife guarantees one fibre, or two from double-yield sources. Without a knife the default chance is 30%. Creative breaking does not produce these survival drops. Packs can change the source tags and chance.

pages.title: Bark
pages.text: Strip a supported log with an axe to receive 1–3 Tree Bark. Bark remembers its wood type and shows the corresponding name and appearance. Stripping gives bark; renewable tapping creates a growing Resin Scar instead.

pages.title: Ochre
pages.text: Break an ochre source, including tagged clay and terracotta. A knife guarantees Raw Ochre; other tools have a default 20% chance. Silk Touch suppresses the extra drop. Grind it in a mortar or quern to produce Ground Ochre.
